=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2285-2294 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a PAT-budget run, the budget path sets `run_meta = {}` (line 2115) and `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or (pat_budget_day_utc is None and len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap)` (line 2290) evaluates to False, so `runs_etag` falls back to `cached_etag` (lines 2291-2294). The cache then stores the previous full-listing ETag next to the nine-workflow subset snapshot. On the next non-budget run GitHub returns 304, and lines 2136-2142 reuse the subset as a complete listing, so runs from other workflows are dropped silently and the repo does not appear in `coverage.repositories_truncated`.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high). minimax and gemini gave confidence 4, glm gave 3. glm notes that the shipped wiring neutralizes it: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:167` forces `AI_MEMORY_ENABLED: 'false'` on the only schedule that passes `--pat-budget-day` (line 188), so this is a latent invariant break and not a live failure. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 agreed it is real in code but listed it only as hardening, for the same reason. Suggested fix from glm and sonnet: `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or pat_budget_day_utc is not None or len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap`.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2075-2081, 2136-2142 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The cached-snapshot check assumes pagination drift can leave a page-limited listing at most one page short of the cap. Duplicate runs are skipped across pages, so drift over several page requests can leave a snapshot smaller than `snapshot_cap` even though `page_limit_reached` was true.
  WHY: The collector caches a partial snapshot together with its ETag. On a later 304, a snapshot below `snapshot_cap` is reused at lines 2136-2142 without the original `page_limit_reached` metadata, so the repo is left out of `coverage.repositories_truncated` (source severity MAJOR).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING (not a finding): scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py | main(), line 2290 `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or (pat_budget_day_utc is None and len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap)`
  PROBLEM: With --pat-budget-day, the cache keeps the previous full-listing ETag (cached_etag, through the run_meta={} fallback at line 2294) next to runs_snapshot_for_repo, which holds only the nine PAT_BUDGET_WORKFLOWS. A manual or future run with the cache enabled would let the next non-budget 304 reuse the subset snapshot as a complete listing (line 2142), and coverage would not report it.
  WHY: The shipped workflow cannot hit this, because .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 167 sets AI_MEMORY_ENABLED=false on the 06:00 schedule. _cache_enabled() (scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:209-211) then returns False, and the cache read/write return early (lines 343 and 371). Suggested fix: `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or pat_budget_day_utc is not None or len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap`. Estimated 1-2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2285 (approx) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On a PAT-budget run, the code wrongly reuses the ETag from a previous full listing when it stores a subset snapshot.
  WHY: `etag_unusable` is False because `pat_budget_day_utc` is set and `repo_truncated` may be False, so `cached_etag` is stored with the subset. On the next non-budget run a 304 reuses the subset as a complete listing, which drops other workflows' runs while the repo is reported as fully covered.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:line 2290, `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or (pat_budget_day_utc is None and len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap)`; related lines 2113-2115, 2291-2294, 2136-2142 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The budget path sets `run_meta = {}` (line 2115), and `etag_unusable` excludes the budget path. When no listing is capped, `runs_etag` therefore resolves to `cached_etag`, and the full-listing ETag is stored next to a nine-workflow subset snapshot.
  WHY: Day 1 non-budget run writes `runs_etag="W/full"`. On Day 2 the 06:00 UTC budget run stores "W/full" with the subset. On the Day 2 12:00 UTC run, the 304 reuses the subset as complete because `snapshot_may_be_partial = len(cached_runs_snapshot) >= snapshot_cap` is False. `coverage.repositories_truncated` does not name the repo, and the misreport persists, which defeats the P3 deliverable.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:line 2290 (`etag_unusable = repo_truncated or (pat_budget_day_utc is None and len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap)`), with line 2115, lines 2292-2294, line 2304, lines 2136-2142 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With `--pat-budget-day` and the cache enabled, `run_meta = {}` leaves `etag_unusable` False. The previous full-listing ETag (`cached_etag`, line 2070) is then persisted next to the subset snapshot, and on the next non-budget 304 the subset is reused as complete. This silently drops runs and leaves `coverage.repositories_truncated` empty, which breaks the invariant stated at lines 2284-2286.
  WHY: It reproduces with `--pat-budget-day` plus a truthy `AI_MEMORY_ENABLED` (the default, `_cache_enabled()` lines 209-211). The shipped wiring neutralizes it: `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:167` forces `AI_MEMORY_ENABLED: 'false'` on the only schedule that passes `--pat-budget-day` (line 188), and `_cache_write_context` (lines 371-372) does nothing in that case, so this is a latent invariant break. Suggested fix: `etag_unusable = repo_truncated or pat_budget_day_utc is not None or len(runs) >= page_snapshot_cap`, plus a regression test for a 304 with the budget day set and the cache enabled.
